items.summary: The official @cockroachjantaparty Instagram account (27M followers) posted a reel of the Tuesday-morning gate-climb captioned: 'In less than 24 hours of Jantar Mantar being denotified as a “designated protest site”, we reclaimed it. This is a message to the government—Hands off people’s Jantar Mantar! Gyanu’s time is over. #CockroachesReassembling.' A companion reel posted minutes earlier (~10:15 AM IST) is captioned 'Reclaiming Jantar Mantar'. This is the party's own official framing of the already-reported ~9:52 AM IST re-detention of Das, Ranka and Shinde at Jantar Mantar.
items.title: Official CJP handle: 'We reclaimed it — hands off people's Jantar Mantar; Gyanu's time is over'

items.summary: The official @cockroachjantaparty account posted handheld footage from inside the detention bus (~31K likes) showing detained CJP team members chanting, raising fists and filming, captioned 'Cockroaches sneaked into Jantar Mantar with the Tiranga today!' — the party's own visual documentation of Tuesday morning's re-detention at Jantar Mantar.
items.title: Official CJP handle posts detention-bus footage: 'Cockroaches sneaked into Jantar Mantar with the Tiranga today!'
